statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail). Let mn be the minimum element of nums (which exists because len(nums) >= 1), let cnt be the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = mn, and let allDiv be the condition that for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] % mn = 0. Then r = (cnt + 1) / 2 (integer division) if allDiv holds, and r = 1 if allDiv does not hold. Equivalently, r is the minimum length of an array achievable from nums by any finite sequence of allowed operations, where an allowed operation on an array A chooses distinct indices i,j with A[i] > 0 and A[j] > 0, removes A[i] and A[j], and appends A[i] % A[j].
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100000, and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.
